title: Startup shader warmup: phase ordering and the release-build readout leak

measurement_that_reframed_this_stage.readme_says: 96 items, about 11.8 s, 6-7 FPS during warmup, 549 MiB texture peak
measurement_that_reframed_this_stage.measured_on_desktop: 96 items, 2.75-2.78 s total, slowest single item 64-65 ms
measurement_that_reframed_this_stage.why_they_differ: the README figure is an Android device measurement; this machine is far faster
measurement_that_reframed_this_stage.first_screen_is_not_blocked: _start_vfx_warmup() is deferred and frame-budgeted (FRAME_BUDGET_MS=12, 2 frames per item), and _show_language_select() runs immediately after it, so the language page appears without waiting for the warmup

conflict_found_and_how_it_was_resolved.readme_asks: split the 96 items into menu-minimal / prep / first-battle-on-demand / background-idle phases
conflict_found_and_how_it_was_resolved.code_forbids: VFXWarmup.gd documents a 28.3 s freeze and a disconnect caused by doing this work while connected, and _process() aborts the moment NetworkService.state != OFFLINE
conflict_found_and_how_it_was_resolved.consequence: any phase deferred past the menu would never run in an online match, so deferring equals cancelling and the shader cost returns to the first battle
conflict_found_and_how_it_was_resolved.resolution: phases were kept entirely inside the offline menu window. The split reorders work instead of deferring it: an early abort now loses the items the player meets last.

menu_minimal.content: the 8 basic attack combinations, played by every unit every round

first_battle.content: skills of buyable race_units and of pve_monsters, i.e. what a first battle actually contains

deferred.content: mercenaries, bosses, formation allies, the hardcoded EXTRA_EFFECTS and the 8 external VFX scenes

ordering_bug_the_split_fixed: the old flat SKILL_TABLES was ordered {race_units, mercenaries, bosses, formation_allies, pve_monsters}, so pve_monsters came last. Round-1 enemy skills were therefore warmed after boss skills the player cannot meet before round 5. They are now in phase 2.

pre_change_baseline.note: same item count and same total; the split reorders, it does not add or remove work

release_readout_leak_fixed.what: _build_label() built its progress readout unconditionally, so a release build drew the warmup progress text over the language-select screen
release_readout_leak_fixed.readme_clause: E3: 可取消且不得在语言页暴露开发文字
release_readout_leak_fixed.fix: guarded with OS.is_debug_build(); a source-level assertion now fails if the guard is removed

not_done_and_why: APK size analysis with aapt/apkanalyzer, ASTC textures, BGM re-encoding per quality tier and the APK size budget are all Android work and remain DEFERRED_BY_USER.
Per-scene resource tables (main menu / prep / battle / boss / codex) were not split out. That is a packaging change whose payoff is APK size, which cannot be measured while Android is paused.
No first-screen time improvement is claimed: the warmup never blocked the first screen on desktop. The headline benefit of E3 remains Android-bound.
